nodes.label: Native installed app discovery catalog
nodes.rationale: Implemented discovery combines bounded Start Menu shortcut traversal, 32/64-bit App Paths and AppsFolder Store metadata. A COM-initialized background scanner replaces in-memory snapshots; icons cache lazily and nothing is uploaded.

nodes.label: Opaque launch IDs and ranked favorites
nodes.rationale: Stable opaque IDs resolve only against the current native catalog. Favorites do not grant or remove launch authority; bounded recency improves similar matches without outranking a better text-match band, and selected IDs survive duplicate names.
